resolutions: D-0032 is resolved in plans/deferrals.md, the ownership lesson now assigns the complete protocol to First under accepted Decision 0067, and the bound plan, graph, decomposition and task plan all agree.

The plan applies the selected Wait for all answer to coordinator transfer: independent dependency-ready work may continue, while transfer waits until every required exchange closes or is canceled; missing or canceled answers grant no authority.
Accepted Decision 0069 permits an exactly bound ledgered empty-frontier cold read to close with zero rounds only after Shared ships; incumbent Decision 0051 floors remain until then.
The AC, roadmap and parity tables are explicitly closure crosswalks only; all active decisions and deterministic gates remain binding even when omitted from a table.

Accepted Decision 0070 allows pre-Quality tasks to record the unavailable new jobs as scheduled gaps, makes Quality the CI producer through a transport-only draft, and requires final platform proof at Quality and Integration.
D-0033 now records Toolshed as a zero-mutation deferral with its exact identity and authority trigger; the three configured clients close Integration while the Toolshed limitation remains explicit.

The full post-implementation verify proves the amended task still fits one bounded session: 17 existing runtime/test paths plus one new schema, at most 3,200 added-plus-deleted lines, inside the 76-path accumulated envelope. Any additional path or cap overrun stops for amendment.

The plan reuses product_excluded_prefixes and product_delta_digest as the sole current delta_id for review and closeout; any compatibility branch_diff_digest field stores that same value and no second identity exists.

Decision 0070 assigns Main the direct GitHub transport action for Quality: push the exact task branch, create or reuse its matching draft, record the PR identity, and grant it no proof or seal authority.

The confirmed capability and architecture permit exactly one citation rejection from the selected combined generation. The amended plan removes rejection chains, binds the successor to that source file SHA256 and ID, and refuses a selected rejection as another source.
A single-lens run is diagnostic only and cannot publish, stamp, revoke or compete with the selected complete generation.

The plan now defines lowercase generation_id from canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON excluding the ID, recomputation on read, real non-symlink directory ancestors, regular single-link leaves, atomic no-overwrite generation publication, byte-identical retry and unequal collision refusal.

Every pass_reports report is recursively validated and projected in exact chunk order; the synthesized top-level summary is not a lens assessment, and the 3,000-character value is correctly treated as an output maximum.

Portable now inventories every task-scoped fixed triple and only uniquely attributable story triples before mutation, binds the sorted inventory digest, handles active versus marker-bound sealed state, and leaves ambiguous or unbound archives display-only.

The plan makes the approved plan and later rendered task contract the classification producers, removes the nonexistent spec claim, and requires complete-input assessment for any reuse across existing gates.
Compaction eligibility now requires exact shipped identity, merged PR and green required CI for scoped and legacy records; legacy pr-ready state alone cannot authorize deletion.
The dogfood target is private vrknetha/symphony-forge-tasktracker-dogfood on main, with absent-name preflight and recorded-ID identity checks for safe partial retry or collision refusal.
Codex 0.153.4 is an explicit pinned story input; the plan makes no fixture-backed or minimum model-support-floor claim and requires amendment for a version change.
The configured client rollout now starts only from the final Quality-or-later harness revision, after Portable, Format and Quality land.
First owns the necessary canonical documentation and graph hunks as task-bound contribution inside its exact envelope; Main owns only planning artifact publication and later client orchestration.

NATIVE-LIFECYCLE owns one codex_runtime shared logger, stderr for local interaction and task-scoped JSONL for durable local evidence, with redaction, correlation, bounded retry and exactly-once unexpected-error metrics.

The plan requires ticket-bearing feature/FORGE-COORD-1-forge-upgrade branches and records an explicit deviation for Cadence and Gantry to branch from and return to their verified main default while ATS uses develop.

The 70 failures reduce to one shared fixture migration plus direct cases in factory/tests/test_close_binds_to_the_diff.py. The amendment adds only that file; test_seal_measures remains validation-only through the shared test_gates helper. Three representative selectors raise the declared total to 61 and the focused batch to twenty-two.

Public record_review_from_json.py --set now accepts only origin=combined, rederives all three exact lens records from decoded raw bytes and authoritative task state, and refuses a caller-supplied mismatch before publication. Rejection and upgrade keep their owned routes into the internal publisher.

The amendment restores exact BEGIN/END FORGE ASSESSMENT <lens> full-line markers and permits one rejection successor only from the selected combined generation. Existing parser and rejection selectors are rewritten in place.
